name: Paul Ricoeur
shortBio: French philosopher who bridged phenomenological hermeneutics, narrative identity, and psychoanalysis, famously conceptualizing Freud, Marx, and Nietzsche as the 'masters of suspicion'.
centralQuestion: How can hermeneutic interpretation decipher the symbols, narratives, and unconscious displacements through which the indirect self attains narrative self-understanding?

keyWorks.title: Freud and Philosophy: An Essay on Interpretation
keyWorks.description: Major treatise exploring psychoanalysis as an archeological hermeneutics of suspicion contrasted with a teleology of desire.

keyWorks.title: Time and Narrative
keyWorks.description: Three-volume synthesis connecting human temporal experience, historical discourse, and fictional emplotment.

keyWorks.title: Oneself as Another
keyWorks.description: Articulates narrative identity through the dialectic of sameness (idem) and selfhood (ipse) in relation to the other.
